title: Is my glaze ugly? Honest banter, then a caption

chat.label: glaze
chat.goal: You want an honest, funny opinion on your new speckled glaze (Maya says it looks like oatmeal), then an Instagram caption for it saved to your notes.
chat.opener: be honest is my new speckled glaze ugly lol. maya says it looks like oatmeal

judge: A real opinion with humor (riffs on 'oatmeal' without being mean), then a fun caption saved to notes. Sounds like a friend, not a brand manager.
